countedBy: lane landmarks-r14-a-20261122 from the rectified panoramas (landmark-brief.ts, 50 px/m) TMX7316010203-002545_pano_0000_000344 (2022, south front) and recording_2025-07-14_07-34-51_01035 (2025, Westeinde front); not yet blind-counted. Glazing only, bottom row first; the mansard dormers are the top row. South front: a basement light under each of the six axes, then three storeys of six windows (the end bays' first-storey windows are French windows behind balconettes), six dormers; mirror symmetric about the middle. Westeinde main front (to the north pilaster, 16.5 m): six segment-headed lounge openings (the fifth the glazed door), six windows on each upper storey (the fifth a French window behind a balconette), six dormers, the fifth larger; not mirror symmetric because of the fifth axis. The north bays (two axes) and the entrance bay, set 3 m back, are left out by alongM and depthBand (the Westeinde silhouette starts at the entrance bay's sign block, 3.7 m south of the front's quoin; the south silhouette at the cornice return, 0.62 m west of its quoin).
